_studyNote_root: Plugin definition for Site Snapshot. Each function name must match a tool in SiteSnapshotCopilotComponent.manifest.json and a Zod schema export. Remove _studyNote_* keys in a real scaffold.
description_for_human: Analyse a SharePoint site's health, and export or email the result.

functions.name: analyzeSite
functions.description: Analyse a site and show a health snapshot.

siteUrl.description: Absolute site URL. Omit for the current site.

staleMonths.description: Months of inactivity that make a document stale.

topN.description: How many largest files to list.

functions.name: exportSnapshot
functions.description: Export the current snapshot to CSV.

functions.name: emailSnapshot
functions.description: Email the current snapshot summary to the user.

recipient.description: Recipient email. Omit to send to the current user.
